items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He got together with Chu Berry as the composer

ctx.x: Well, it got out that Chu Berry wrote the tune. So all this had happened before I was aware that it was happening. So there was a publishing company right there in the Roseland

which was quite convenient. building, right upstairs, (unintelligible). I'll never forget this in my life. Called Joe Davis Music Publishing Company, Incorporated. He got together with Chu Berry as the composer, wrote the tune, and I don't think Chu made any money out of it. He bought it outright from him. In those days they knew rather than take him on a commission all those things and would take (unintelligible) sort of and take a thing, chance on the thing. He bought it outright, and the guy made over…
